description: This file defines a utility enum 'LoopbackHost' with static methods to determine if a given hostname or IP address is a loopback or local network address. It includes functions for parsing IP addresses and checking specific address ranges.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Determines if the provided host string represents a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if the given hostname or IP address is a loopback address, considering IPv4 and IPv6 standards.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Determines if the host is in the local network, including loopback, local TLDs, or private IP ranges.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a string into an IPv4 address tuple if valid.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within known local network IP ranges.
